newsitem.title: USA: Brazil's Telebras in capitalization pact.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras in capitalization pact.

text.p: Telecomunicacoes Brasileiras SA on Friday said it signed a contract with Banco de Desenvolvimento Economico e Social to capitalize autofinancing contracts fully paid in 1996.

Telebras said the pact would allow its subsidiaries to refund fees paid by subscribers. It also makes possible the immediate collection of 110 million reais from the sale of subscription rights, the Brazilian telecommunications concern said in a statement.

Telebras said the accord paved the way for placement of the shares of Telebras' subsidiaries in stock markets. It said there will be a call option on supplementary profits from future sales of its subsidiaries' shares made by the bank.
